description: This file defines the WorkflowRepository class with methods for managing workflows, including retrieval, filtering, deletion of reminders, and related operations in a TypeScript project using Prisma ORM.

classes.name: WorkflowRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing static methods for managing workflows, including CRUD operations, filtering, and reminder management.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Fetches a workflow by its ID with detailed related data.

methods.name: getVerifiedNumbers
methods.description: Retrieves verified phone numbers associated with a user or team.

methods.name: getVerifiedEmails
methods.description: Retrieves verified emails for a user, including team members if applicable.

methods.name: getFilteredList
methods.description: Returns a list of workflows filtered by user permissions and optional filters.

methods.name: getRemindersFromRemovedTeams
methods.description: Identifies reminders to delete when teams are removed.

methods.name: getActiveOnEventTypeIds
methods.description: Gets event type IDs associated with a specific workflow.

methods.name: deleteAllWorkflowReminders
methods.description: Deletes scheduled reminders for workflows based on provided reminder data.

methods.name: findUniqueForUpdate
methods.description: Finds a unique workflow for update purposes.

methods.name: findUniqueWithRelations
methods.description: Retrieves a workflow with related data for editing.

methods.name: findActiveOrgWorkflows
methods.description: Finds active workflows for an organization, considering permissions and trigger exclusions.

methods.name: findTeamWorkflows
methods.description: Finds workflows associated with a specific team.

methods.name: findUserWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves workflows for a specific user.

methods.name: findAllWorkflows
methods.description: Retrieves all workflows accessible to a user.

methods.name: findWorkflowsActiveOnRoutingForm
methods.description: Finds workflows active on a specific routing form.

methods.name: findActiveWorkflowsOnTeam
methods.description: Finds active workflows for a team, including those active on all teams.
